clauses.scope_note: Applies to the SemanticEmbed SDK, described in lines 9–11 as a compiled package for interfacing with the SemanticEmbed cloud API. The text prohibits unauthorized copying, distribution, modification, or use; it does not specify what authorizes an activity.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the relevant activity is unauthorized. The text does not define authorization or grant permission for any activity.

coverage_notes: Lines 13–14 describe free and paid tiers: the free tier is limited to graphs of up to 50 nodes and requires no signup; the paid tier allows unlimited nodes and requires a valid license key. They do not expressly grant a license or specify a payment obligation or amount.
The stated sole purpose of interfacing with the cloud API (lines 9–11) describes the SDK but does not expressly establish a separate permission or prohibition.
No operative terms address sublicensing, combining, source provision, training, output rights, or other listed activities; their status is unspecified, not prohibited.
The patent-pending statement and licensing contact do not supply patent-license terms or additional activity permissions.
